text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... That is correct, Chan-me is 
lacking sleep.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Have you heard of 'spy fountain pens'? 
The ink disappears after a little while."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It was such a fun spy gadget, but... I 
accidentally used that fountain pen to do 
my homework, and..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was focusing so hard on fixing it... 
that the sky outside grew bright—*yawn*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Aston Machan wasn't able to get a 
good rest.
